scope.selection: Only PUBLICATION.json files plus PUBLICATION.json metadata; no directory-wide content scan.

genericCandidateDisposition.assessment: All 18 generic matches occur in test source or saved test patches. URL cases have synthetic/example test context; assignment cases have synthetic markers or descriptive placeholder shapes, including the transcript fixture's loopback provider. No matched values were emitted.
genericCandidateDisposition.limits: This is source-context classification, not live credential validation. No endpoint was contacted.

limitations: Pattern matching cannot prove absence of all credentials; arbitrary unprefixed, encoded, split, encrypted, or unknown-format secrets can evade detection.
Candidate paths/counts are emitted without matched values; synthetic test/example candidates require context review before disposition.
No known-real-key comparison was performed and no real key file or existing runtime profile was opened.
Binary files were scanned as bytes for ASCII signatures; no OCR, decompression, decryption, or full binary semantic inspection was performed.
Build and Git directories may be created concurrently; they are outside the explicit manifest scan and no claim is made about their contents.
Publication metadata records hashes but is not an authenticity signature; this check compares bytes against the locally reviewed manifest.
